## Review

The rate limiting implementation in `src/auth/limiter.ts` is mostly solid. Three findings:

### Token bucket (correct)
The refill logic on lines 22-31 computes refill from elapsed time and clamps to capacity. Good.

### Redis expiry (suggestion)
In `src/auth/cache.ts` the key is written with `set` then `expire` as two calls. Consider `SET key value EX ttl` so a crash between the two can't leave a key without a TTL:

```ts
await redis.set(key, count, 'EX', ttl);
```

### Race condition (must fix)
Lines 40-48 do a read-modify-write on the bucket count that is not atomic — two concurrent requests can both read the same count and both pass the limit. Use an `INCR`-based atomic check or a Lua script on the login endpoint instead.

Net: address the race condition before merge; the expiry change is a nice-to-have.
